page.layout: Folded sheet, seen as a grid of panels. Top row: left panel with ovals and a small label at top left; centre panel with a large title in capitals ("ARBOR" with a second word that I cannot read), a small framed text block under it, and a central oval diagram; right panel with ovals. Middle row: left panel with ovals; centre panel with large ovals and a small text block; right panel with ovals. Bottom row: left framed text block of several lines; centre panel with a small framed block; right framed block; all under a diagram of connected boxes. Margins: none with printed text, apart from show-through at the edges.
page.notes: The sheet is folded and photographed flat, so several panels overlap and show mirrored text from the reverse. That show-through is excluded. The oval and box labels are a few pixels high and cannot be read letter by letter, so each is marked as illegible rather than guessed. The large title in the top centre panel can be made out only partly. The bottom framed text blocks show some lines, but these are too faint to read. Please provide a higher-resolution scan, ideally one panel at a time, and I will transcribe each panel in full, including the diagram structure with its levels.
